name: Novu Free
free_limit: 10,000 workflow runs/month on Novu Cloud Free; up to 20 workflows, 2 environments (Dev/Prod), 3 team members and all notification channels
watch_out: No credit card required. Free activity-feed retention is 24 hours and event trigger throughput is limited to 60/sec. Free includes US/EU data residency; removing Novu branding, seven-day retention and increased workflow throughput require a paid plan. Email/SMS delivery providers may charge separately.
